title: v1_91 / Debug
content: ## Debug ### JavaScript debugger The JavaScript debugger now shows the correct value of shadowed variables when hovering over them and in inline values (enabled via the debug.inlineValues setting), based on the program's scopes. ![JavaScript code snippet that shows an overlay with the value of shadowed variables.](images/1_91/debug-shadowed.png) _Theme: [Codesong](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=connor4312.codesong) (preview on [vscode.dev](https://vscode.dev/editor/theme/connor4312.codesong))_
